policies.name: All CA policies must have an explicit State
policies.description: A Conditional Access policy with no State property cannot be evaluated or enforced.
policies.remediation: Ensure the policy has a valid State (enabled, disabled, enabledForReportingButNotEnforced).

policies.name: Disabled CA policies should not remain in tenant
policies.description: Disabled policies are dead weight and may indicate incomplete rollouts.
policies.remediation: Delete the policy or bring it to an enabled state.
